objective: Make validation-runner peak-memory diagnostics portable to Windows and other supported platforms without reporting a false zero when measurement is unavailable.
previous_knowledge_consumed: CI run 40123404290 passed tests and packaging but failed Dependency Audit because this older branch pinned msgpack==1.2.2 and filelock==4.0.3; current main pins msgpack==1.2.3 and filelock==4.2.1.

baseline.status: The runner imports the POSIX-only resource module at module load and uses it directly; the initial CI run reports Ruff I001 and prevents downstream jobs from running.
baseline.description: undefined The branch lockfile has now been synchronized with current main's msgpack==1.2.3 and filelock==4.2.1 pins.

correctness.before: Unconditional resource import can prevent module import on Windows
correctness.after: Platform-specific measurement is isolated and unavailable measurements are represented as null with an explicit status

reliability.before: Windows may fail before validation starts
reliability.after: Windows uses a guarded standard-library Win32 API path; POSIX imports resource only inside the measurement helper

reproducibility.before: Peak-memory measurement semantics are platform-dependent and implicit
reproducibility.after: Metric name and unavailable status are explicit in the output

evidence: Initial CI run 40122822486: Format Check passed; Lint failed on Ruff I001 in runner.py; downstream jobs were skipped.
A follow-up commit adds the required import/function separation and this lifecycle record; the new head's CI still needs to complete.
Current-main requirements.lock was copied to this branch to remove stale msgpack==1.2.2 and filelock==4.0.3 pins; fresh dependency audit and full CI are pending.

root_causes: The helper was inserted with only one blank line after the import block, triggering Ruff I001.
The initial PR did not include a machine-readable cumulative lifecycle record, which must be present for meaningful changes.
The latest observed CI run also failed Dependency Audit because the branch retained outdated dependency pins from its older base; the branch lockfile is now synchronized with current main.

findings: Do not import POSIX-only resource at module load in code intended to run on Windows.
If a diagnostic cannot be measured, emit null plus an explicit status rather than a fabricated numeric value.
Every meaningful PR must include a valid lifecycle cycle record.

open_blockers: Fresh current-head CI must pass, including Dependency Audit, package verification, and all tests.
Verify the Windows memory API path on an actual Windows runner or clearly document that the regression test only exercises the failure path on POSIX.

knowledge_carried_forward: cross-platform support must be verified on actual supported operating systems
diagnostic values must preserve unavailable-state semantics
